messages:
Alex Garcia: Quick question re: partner SEV routing for HW vendors — if a partner opens a severity 1 incident from a marketplace listing, what's our on-call flow? Do we triage in the shared partner channel or open a private warroom?
Maya Chen: Short answer: open a private warroom + notify @Marketplace Oncall + reach out to the HW vendor POC. We should follow the runbook links when available. :book: 
Samir Patel: TL;DR of what works: 1) ACK in the partner channel, 2) create private channel `#partner-warroom-<partner>-sev1`, 3) spin up a phone bridge, 4) do initial triage, 5) escalate to vendor if HW.
Elaine Brooks: Important: split by root cause early — HW (GPU/firmware), infra (host/driver), or software (agent/model). If HW, include serial numbers + instance IDs in the first post.
Alex Garcia: Can we standardize the warroom naming + initial post template? That speeds handoffs a lot.
Jorge Alvarez: I drafted a minimal template below. Use it when creating the warroom so vendor and sales have everything up front.
Jorge Alvarez: ```
/create-channel #partner-warroom-ACME-sev1 private
Topic: SEV1 — ACME Marketplace GPU outage
Participants: @Marketplace Oncall @AlexGarcia @MayaChen @SamirPatel @ElaineBrooks <partner_poc>
Bridge: +1-555-0123 (pin 4321)
Initial post: 
- Impact: X customers affected
- Start time (UTC):
- Affected SKUs/Models/Instances: (include AMI/instance IDs)
- Immediate actions taken: (restarts, instance repro, driver dump)
- Vendor ask: remote diag + serial lookup + replacement ETA
Tags: env:prod, marketplace_listing_id:12345, dedicated_customer_id:67890
```
Marketplace Oncall: Also add `region:` and `model_variant:` fields, and include GPU telemetry links (Grafana). If it's a dedicated deployment, add the customer org ID and contact.
Maya Chen: Escalation timeline suggestion: vendor ACK within 10m; if no ACK escalate to partner account manager + Sales Engineering + PagerDuty vendor-escalation policy at 15m.
Samir Patel: Who owns the owner assignment? Initial triage = Eng oncall (first 15m). Partner ops or AE should own vendor comms + SLAs after we confirm it's HW.
Elaine Brooks: Agreed. I'll add a note in the playbook: "Eng oncall performs triage and evidence collection; Partner Ops owns vendor coordination and commercial/credits decisions."
partner-bot: Channel `#partner-warroom-ACME-sev1` created by Alex Garcia
Alex Garcia: :thumbsup: I'll create a Confluence incident doc from this template and link it into the warroom. Need to ensure RCA owner is assigned within 24h.
Jorge Alvarez: Postmortem checklist (add to template): timeline, root cause, vendor action taken, customer impact summary, credits decision + owner, and follow-ups.
Maya Chen: Add watchers: eng-sre, eng-runtime, and product-marketplace to the warroom for the first 60 mins. Also update PagerDuty escalation if vendor is unresponsive.
Elaine Brooks: I'll draft the updated 'Partner SEV Playbook' with the channel naming, templates, and escalation matrix. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
Alex Garcia: Thanks everyone. If anyone has up-to-date vendor phone numbers or escalation POCs, drop them in the warroom ASAP so partner ops can call them directly.
Maya Chen: One more small thing — include a step to capture whether the affected models are quantized or running fp16/INT8; that often changes vendor triage steps.
Samir Patel: Noted. We'll add a quick checklist item for model runtime bits.
Alex Garcia: Great. I'll start the channel when a partner pings us; keeping this thread as the mini spec.
